UnmappedDataByDomain:SourceValueCnt: Count of source values in unmapped data
AgeAtFirstObsByDecile:DecileCnt: Count of deciles appearing in the data (at first observation)
Meas:NoNumValue:Percentage: Percentage of rows in MEASUREMENT table that have NULL recorded as numerical value
UnmappedData:byDomain:Percentage: Percentage of rows that are unmapped
Provider:SpeciatlyCnt: Count of specialties found in the provider table
ach_2000:Percentage: Percentage of patients with at least 1 Dx and 1 Rx
ach_2001:Percentage: Percentage of patients with at least 1 Dx and 1 Proc
ach_2002:Percentage: Percentage of patients with at least 1 Meas, 1 Dx and 1 Rx
ach_2003:Percentage: Percentage of patients with at least 1 visit
Visit:Type:PersonWithAtLeastOne:byDecile: Percentage of patients that have at least one visit by visity type
Death:byYear:SafePatientCnt: Count of patients by year of death
Death:BornDeceasedRatio: Ratio of born persons to deceased persons by year

UnmappedDataByDomain:SourceValueCnt: The measure analyzes how many source codes are unmapped.
AgeAtFirstObsByDecile:DecileCnt: The measure analyzes deciles of patients at their first observation. If only certain age groups are being observed, the count of deciles will be low.
Provider:PatientProviderRatio: The measure looks at how many patients and how many providers are defined in the data. For example, the ratio may indicate abnormaly low number of providers.
Meas:NoNumValue:Percentage: The measure looks at data recorded in MESUREMENT table. A significant percentage of such rows typically contain a numerical result.
UnmappedData:byDomain:Percentage: The measure looks at relative size of unmapped data.
Provider:SpeciatlyCnt: The measure looks at how many different specialties are present. For general datasets, we expect at least some minimum number of specialties.
DrugExposure:ConceptCnt: Count of distinct drugs. For most datasets, a low number may indicate a data quality problem.
ach_2000:Percentage: Indicates patient with some minimum events in their record
ach_2001:Percentage: Indicates patient with some minimum events in their record
ach_2002:Percentage: Indicates patient with some minimum events in their record
ach_2003:Percentage: Indicates patient with some minimum events in their record
Achilles:byAnalysis:RowCnt: Metadata about which measures were included when Achilles was last executed. Also allows count of types for certain domains (e.g., visit type). This is least sensitive data about a dataset. Pure metadata.
Visit:Type:PersonWithAtLeastOne:byDecile: The measure indicates which visit types are present in the dataset by decile using non-sensitive percentage view of count of persons.
Device:ConceptCnt: Count of distinct concepts. For most datasets, a low number may indicate a data quality problem.
Measurement:ConceptCnt: Count of distinct concepts. For most datasets, a low number may indicate a data quality problem.
Observation:ConceptCnt: Count of distinct concepts. For most datasets, a low number may indicate a data quality problem.
Procedure:ConceptCnt: Count of distinct concepts. For most datasets, a low number may indicate a data quality problem.
Note:ConceptCnt: Count of distinct concepts. For most datasets, a low number may indicate a data quality problem.
Death:DeathCause:ConceptCnt: Count of distinct concepts. For most datasets, a low number may indicate a data quality problem.
Death:DeathType:ConceptCnt: Count of distinct concepts. For most datasets, a low number may indicate a data quality problem.
Death:byYear:SafePatientCnt: Safe patient count indicates that low counts will not be included in the measure
Death:byDecade:SafePatientCnt: Count of deaths by calendar decade (e.g., 1990s, 2000s,2100s). Large aggretion by decade is a less sensitive measure to report.
